subject: Follow-up: Pricing & token volumes — Strella AI pilot
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anika Singh <anika@strella.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Pricing & token volumes — Strella AI pilot

Hi Anika — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our call and a couple of asks so we can put together a tailored pricing/commitment proposal: 

- Goals: pilot personalization features (reranking + generation for 1:1 messages) for 50k MAU target during pilot ramp, with peak concurrently served users ~2k.
- Current model profile: expect ~1.2k tokens per end-user session (avg across text + context; bursts up to 3k for longer threads).
- Success criteria: latency below 600ms p95 for interactive flows; cost target ~ $1,000–$3,000/month during pilot.

Please confirm/correct the above numbers. Two specific asks so we can model unit economics:
1) Can you share an expected monthly token volume (rough estimate is fine) — e.g., tokens/month or messages/day?
2) What is the target budget range for the pilot and for an expected scale 6–12 months out (ballpark is fine).

As a reminder, we have a startup program (if you meet the criteria it can stack with a committed-use discount), and we can also price a 12– or 24‑month committed-use plan that materially reduces $/1M tokens. If you want, I can sketch three pricing scenarios: pay-as-you-go, 12‑month commitment, and 24‑month commitment with multi-year incentives.

Next steps: If you can reply with token estimate + target budget I’ll run unit-economics back-of-envelope and send a term sheet and SOW outline by EOD Friday.

Thanks —
Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0134

--
Redwood Inference — Production-first inference runtime & managed serving
From: Anika Singh <anika@strella.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ravi Patel <ravi@strella.ai>
Date: Thu, 9 Jul 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Pricing & token volumes — Strella AI pilot

Thanks Marissa — great summary and yes, accurate. A few numbers to help model this: 

- Pilot horizon: 3 months (July–Sept) with expected tokens: ~120M tokens/month in month 1 ramping to ~400M tokens/month by month 3 (peak).
- Production target (6–12 months): assume 1.2–1.8B tokens/month as we onboard additional customers.
- Budget: pilot budget is tight — target $2k–$5k/month. For production we could stretch to $25k–$40k/month depending on SLA and price per 1M tokens.

Question: what is a realistic $/1M tokens for a quantized open model in your catalog at the committed-use tiers? Also, does your startup program apply to Strella AI (we received YC support last year)?

We’d love to see example scenarios (PAYG vs 12m vs 24m committed) with target $/1M and what volume tiers trigger which discounts.

—Anika
Head of Product, Strella AI
anika@strella.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anika Singh <anika@strella.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Jul 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Pricing & token volumes — Strella AI pilot

Hi Anika — great context, that helps a lot. High level price ranges (illustrative) we can model for the scenarios you asked about — I’ll attach a short term sheet next. 

- PAYG (no commit): ~ $35–$55 per 1M tokens depending on model variant and latency SLO.
- 12‑month committed-use (mid tier): target range ~ $18–$28 per 1M tokens for 3–12 month committed volumes (volume bands apply; higher bands reduce price).
- 24‑month committed + multi-year incentive: we can push to ~$10–$20 per 1M tokens depending on volume bands, minimum annual commitment, and payment terms.

Startup program: yes — Strella qualifies for our startup program (congrats on YC!). That gives a one-time credit + eligibility for an additional 10% off on top of committed-use pricing for the first 12 months. I’ve looped in Laura (revOps) to confirm stacking rules and to sign off on the proposed discounts.

A couple of clarifying questions to correctly size the committed tiers: 
- For committed-use, do you prefer an annual dollar commit (e.g., $X/year) or a token-based commit (e.g., Y tokens/month)? Both work; we typically see finance prefer dollar commits for simpler P&L mapping.
- Is Strella open to a 12m pilot commitment at a discounted tier (e.g., commit to $60k for 12 months) if that aligns to the production ramp? We can back into $/1M tokens from there.

I attached a short draft term sheet and a sample pilot scope and metrics workbook for you to review. If it looks good I can run a formal pricing quote and a DocuSign envelope for signature.

Proposed next step: 30‑minute session early next week with Ravi + your finance lead to go through the term sheet and commit options.

Thanks —
Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: Strella_Commitment_Term_Sheet_v1.pdf (pdf, 42KB); pilot_scope_and_metrics.xlsx (xlsx, 18KB)
From: Anika Singh <anika@strella.ai>

Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Pricing & token volumes — Strella AI pilot

Thanks Marissa — the numbers look reasonable and the startup stacking is great news. We’re targeting PAYG for the first 6 weeks, but if the pilot metrics hold we’ll come back with an ask to move to a 12m dollar commitment.
